cohort: Same eight fixed held-out meshes plus sphere, torus, two spheres; no resampling of cases.
complete_policy: For distance_prior != none, complete=1 or legacy None selects the native direct surfel distance. Explicit complete=0 retains the original learned distance. Normal outputs and state-dict keys remain unchanged.

mask.procedure: Native visible_mask with stable_seed(seed, id + :mask, 0). One fixed mask per shape. The realised area fraction is recorded.
mask.frame: Visible surface only; output distances are converted to the original complete-input RMS radius for comparison.
mask.symmetries: Recomputed from visible input only; never reuse complete-input maps.

evaluation.truth: Same saved exact-distance field and grid; same corrected landmarks and 26-neighbour tube paths.
evaluation.distance: Maximum absolute error on saved grids, original independent probes, and separately the visible and hidden original surface samples. Finite sampled maxima, not certified continuous bounds.
evaluation.derived: Same-radius tube-volume area estimator, Betti numbers, tube path errors including lost paths, and full/capped persistence diagrams.
evaluation.precision: float32 inference, no autocast, TF32 off

scope: No retraining or fitted calibration. One masking seed; exploratory evidence rather than a population or continuum guarantee.
expectation: Complete routing must equal the native disks. Under masking, report whether learned distance and derived metrics beat the visible disks; retain negative outcomes.
execution: Complete routing regression on every saved packet; masked original/fixed parity; native independent disk formula cross-check; saved masks and prepared packets.
